name: Petrify
description: Petrify device discovery, playback handoff and listening-party relay.
overview: Runs the bundled Petrify relay with Jellyfin, with validated network and party timing settings and an optional browser health check.

versions.changelog: Relay 1.2.3: fixes reaction delivery from connected voters who are not Party playback members, ensures zone-targeted reactions also reach the host, validates reactions consistently across clients, and returns actionable errors for rejected party actions.
